definitions.explanation: Loss of hope or enthusiasm; being discouraged by failure.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}に{落胆|らくたん}した。
examples.english: I was disappointed by the results.

examples.japanese: {落胆|らくたん}を{隠|かく}せなかった。
{落胆|らくたん}している{場合|ばあい}ではない。
examples.english: This is not the time to be dejected.

notes:
{落胆|らくたん} expresses disappointment or discouragement, typically at a deeper level than casual disappointment.

WORD FORMATION:
{落|らく} (fall) + {胆|たん} (courage/spirit) — literally "one's spirit falls"

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{落胆|らくたん}する: to be disappointed by ~
- {落胆|らくたん}を{隠|かく}せない: unable to hide disappointment
- {落胆|らくたん}している{場合|ばあい}ではない: no time to be dejected

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than がっかり. Common in news reports, written language, and formal speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- がっかり: disappointed (casual, everyday)
- {失望|しつぼう}: disappointment (also formal)
